name: Peki – Fiken Integration for WooCommerce
author: PEKI LTD

sections.description:
Peki – Fiken Integration for WooCommerce connects your WooCommerce store with the Norwegian accounting platform Fiken. When orders are completed in WooCommerce, the plugin can automatically create vouchers in Fiken — saving time and reducing manual errors.

More info: https://www.fikenplugin.no

Free tier: Includes 15 transfers per month.
Multi-site: Unlimited number of WordPress sites can connect to the same Fiken company — usage is aggregated per company_slug (shared monthly quota).
Upgrade plans: see Pricing below.

Built for merchants who want a reliable, compliant WooCommerce–Fiken integration (accounting, bookkeeping, VAT/MVA) tailored to Norway.

Independent plugin. This is a third-party connector by Peki. We are not affiliated with Fiken AS or WooCommerce/Automattic.

Why choose this plugin?

  • Automatic bookkeeping: Completed WooCommerce orders can be exported to Fiken.
  • Simple setup: Connect your store to Fiken in a few steps.
  • Save time and reduce errors: Less manual data entry.
  • WordPress coding standards: Stability and security focused.

Key Features

  • Connect WooCommerce to Fiken
  • Automatically export completed orders to Fiken
  • Refund handling: create credit notes in Fiken
  • Multi-site by company slug: unlimited stores per Fiken account (shared quota)
  • GDPR-aware: only the data required for the voucher is sent
  • Translation-ready (peki-fiken-integration-for-woocommerce)

Requirements (Fiken)

1) Enable Fiken API (paid add-on):
In Fiken: Foretak → Tillegstjenester → API (kr 99,- / month). This must be active for the integration to work.

2) First invoice note (important):
If your Fiken account has never issued an invoice, create one (draft/send) so Fiken starts its invoice counter. Some Fiken flows require the counter to be initialized before API-created vouchers can proceed.

Pricing

Free
– 15 transfers / month
– Unlimited websites per Fiken company*
– Shared quota per company slug

Starter – 149 NOK / month
– Up to 100 transfers / month
– Unlimited websites per Fiken company*
– Shared quota per company slug

Growth – 399 NOK / month
– Up to 1,000 transfers / month
– Unlimited websites per Fiken company*
– Shared quota per company slug

Pro – 799 NOK / month
– Up to 5,000 transfers / month
– Unlimited websites per Fiken company*
– Shared quota per company slug

* All connected WordPress sites that use the same Fiken company (company_slug) share one monthly quota.

External services

This plugin connects to Peki’s export service and the Fiken API to process exports outside your WordPress site.

  • Peki export service (peki.no)
    Securely processes WooCommerce order data and forwards it to the Fiken API.
    When data is sent: When you connect/disconnect or trigger an export (automatically on order status).
    What data is sent:
    – Site URL and technical identifiers for troubleshooting
    – Order data required to create vouchers (order ID, totals, currency, taxes, line items/product, quantity, unit price, tax)
    – Customer details required by Fiken (e.g., name and email), when applicable
    – Integration identifiers returned during the connect flow (e.g., company slug / tokens)
    Provider: Peki AS (peki.no) — Terms and Privacy on peki.no.

  • Fiken (fiken.no)
    Accounting platform and API used to create vouchers.
    When data is sent: When the export service calls Fiken’s API on your behalf.
    What data is sent: Voucher information derived from your WooCommerce orders and your integration identifiers.
    Provider: Fiken (fiken.no) — see Fiken’s Terms and Privacy.

By using this plugin you accept that processing happens on external servers (peki.no and fiken.no).

Privacy

  • Only the data required to complete the export is transmitted.
  • No analytics/telemetry is collected by the plugin.
  • Review external providers’ policies for processing and retention details.

Who is this plugin for?

  • Norwegian WooCommerce stores using Fiken for accounting
  • Small and medium-sized online businesses
  • Merchants who want to automate bookkeeping

Translations

All user-facing strings use the text domain peki-fiken-integration-for-woocommerce.
To contribute translations, place .po/.mo files under /languages/.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/peki-fiken-integration-for-woocommerce or install from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin from Plugins in WordPress.

Important: Before connecting to Fiken, you must:

  1. Enable the Fiken API add-on in your Fiken account:

    • Go to Fiken → Foretak → Tillegstjenester → API
    • Activate the API module (NOK 99/month)

  2. Create your first invoice in Fiken (if you haven’t already):

    • Create and send at least one invoice from Fiken
    • This initializes the invoice counter and customer counter
    • Without this, API-created vouchers may fail

  3. Go to Peki → Fiken in the WordPress admin menu and follow the steps to connect your store to Fiken.

  4. Completed orders will be transferred to Fiken automatically.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Fiken account?

Yes. You need an active Fiken account with the API module (“Foretak → Tillegstjenester → API”) enabled in Fiken (paid add-on).

Does the plugin work for companies that are not VAT-registered?

No. The plugin currently targets companies registered for VAT.

Can I connect multiple WordPress stores?

Yes. You can connect unlimited stores to the same Fiken company. All stores that share the same company_slug use a shared monthly quota.

Is my data safe?

Yes. Data is sent over secure connections, and sensitive financial data is not stored locally. See “External services” for details.
sections.changelog:
1.0.6

  • Fix: PHPCS warnings resolved for OAuth callback handling and webhook signature validation.
  • Improvement: Enhanced installation instructions with mandatory Fiken API activation and first invoice creation.
  • Docs: Clarified that Fiken invoice counter and customer counter must be initialized before API integration works.
  • Security: Proper sanitization and unslashing of server variables in webhook endpoint.

1.0.5

  • Fix: Duplicate “Connect to Fiken” notice; render guarded to run once per request.
  • Improvement: Quota notices now read from cached server status (shared per company_slug), with webhook/cron refresh.
  • Docs: Added Fiken API add-on requirement and first-invoice note; clarified multi-site behavior and pricing plans.
  • Meta: Bumped “Tested up to” to 6.8; updated Stable tag.

1.0.4

  • Docs: English-only readme per WordPress.org requirements; improved SEO wording for WooCommerce/Fiken integration in Norway.
  • Product: Clarified free tier (15 transfers/month) and option to upgrade to unlimited.
  • Docs: Removed references to manual “Send to Fiken” actions and subscription support (not available).
  • Link: Added https://www.fikenplugin.no in the description.

1.0.3

  • Compliance: Neutralized upgrade/plan wording; “Manage Subscription” link only.
  • Security: Reviewed nonce and capability checks in connect/disconnect flows.
  • Prefix: Migrated internal keys to pekifiken_ with legacy fallbacks.
  • API: Plan/limits decided by remote service; plugin surfaces neutral errors.
  • Docs: Expanded “External services.”

1.0.2

  • Documentation updates and refund handling improvements.

1.0.1

  • Fix: Dismissible admin notices; clarified docs.

1.0.0

  • First public release.
